description: This file contains the PHP class 'Latest' which extends the Product model in the OpenCart catalog extension module. It defines a method 'getLatest' to retrieve the latest products, including SQL query construction, caching, and data retrieval logic.

classes.name: Latest
classes.description: A class that extends the Product model to add functionality for retrieving the latest products with filtering, caching, and database query execution.

methods.name: getLatest
methods.description: Retrieves the latest products up to a specified limit, utilizing caching and constructing a SQL query to fetch data from the database.
